mapper.sql: select o.outbound_order_id, o.outbound_order_no, o.outbound_type, o.source_type, o.source_no, o.customer_id, o.customer_name, o.supplier_id, o.supplier_name, o.warehouse_id, o.warehouse_name, o.outbound_date, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.order_status, d.item_summary, o.audit_by, o.audit_time, o.pick_by, o.pick_time, o.post_by, o.post_time, o.cancel_by, o.cancel_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from erp_outbound_order o left join ( select outbound_order_id, group_concat(concat_ws(' / ', item_code, item_name, color_name, spec_name, batch_no) order by outbound_detail_id separator ';') as item_summary from erp_outbound_order_detail group by outbound_order_id ) d on d.outbound_order_id = o.outbound_order_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_outbound_order(outbound_order_no, outbound_type, source_type, source_no, customer_id, customer_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, outbound_date, total_qty, total_amount, order_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{outboundOrderNo}, #{outboundType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{outboundDate}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update erp_outbound_order set outbound_type = #{outboundType}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_no = #{sourceNo}, customer_id = #{customerId}, customer_name = #{customerName}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, outbound_date = #{outboundDate}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} and order_status = '草稿'

update erp_outbound_order set order_status = '已出库', audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, pick_by = #{pickBy}, pick_time = #{pickTime}, post_by = #{postBy}, post_time = #{postTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} and order_status in ('草稿', '已审核', '已拣货')

update erp_outbound_order set order_status = '已取消', cancel_by = #{cancelBy}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} and order_status = '已出库'
mapper.delete: delete from erp_outbound_order where order_status = '草稿' and outbound_order_id in #{outboundOrderId}
